question: Does the proposed eightfold fold/multi-interval completion derive physical quotient locality and an E8 field extension from the same source while preserving the quarter phase, state and time?
scope: Known single-complex-charged-CAR representative and the full mass=1, ny=8 QWZ source, with the stipulated canonical common-current time and E8 stress-form premise. The quarter phase is retained. The source-specific analytic spectral obstruction applies to this noninteracting source and a common-Hilbert, source-state/time-preserving limit. The KLM label count is only for KLMVACUUM_REFERENCEV2Z; the actual quarter-source global dual-index is not proved. This is not a derivation from raw P1/P2 or a universal TFPT no-go.
summary_de: Auf der unveränderten bekannten geladenen CAR/QWZ-Quelle kann die vorgeschlagene Achtfachfaltung mit Mehrintervallvervollständigung keine physische Quotientenlokalität und E8-Felderweiterung herleiten, wenn Viertelphase, Zustand und gemeinsame physikalische Zeit erhalten bleiben. Der zusätzliche E8-Nullzustand wird durch die Weyl-Abbildung zu e1+e4, einer gewöhnlichen neutralen D5-Trägerwurzel; die ursprüngliche Quelle hat im selben Zeitmaß nur den eindeutigen Fock-Grundzustand. Der volle QWZ-Operator besitzt analytisch einen gleichmäßigen skalierten Einteilchengap ≥1/(2π), dessen Untergrenze gegen 1/4 geht. Der KLM-Index 4^7=16384 ist nur die Referenz-Vakuumsektor-Klassifikation, kein nachgewiesener globaler Dualindex der tatsächlichen Viertelquelle. Kein allgemeiner P1/P2- oder TFPT-No-go.
summary_en: On the unchanged known charged-CAR/QWZ source, the proposed eightfold fold and multi-interval completion do not derive physical quotient locality and an E8 field extension while preserving the quarter phase, state, and common physical time. The additional E8 zero-state maps under the stipulated Weyl map to e1+e4, an ordinary neutral D5 carrier root; the original source has only its unique Fock ground state in the same time normalization. The full QWZ operator has an analytic uniform scaled one-particle gap at least 1/(2π), with bound limit 1/4. The KLM index 4^7=16384 is only the vacuum-reference sector classification, not a proved global dual index for the actual quarter source. No universal P1/P2 or TFPT no-go is claimed.
assumptions: The actual source is the specified known single-complex-charged-CAR representative and full mass=1, ny=8 QWZ cylinder; this representative is not derived from raw P1/P2.
The E8 common stress/time formula is a premise for the extension-side ground-space comparison, not a result derived from P1/P2.
KLMVACUUM_REFERENCEV2Z labels satisfy r in Z4^8 with sum r_i=0 mod 4; count 4^7=16384 does not establish the actual quarter-twisted source global dual-index or complement transport.

The neutral geometry counterexample uses only the stipulated deck-invariant function f(theta)=cos(2theta)+2sin(2theta); deck invariance alone does not prohibit a separately selected relocalization, gauge action, or observable completion.

The source-specific no-extra-ground-state conclusion requires a common-Hilbert, source-state/time-preserving limit retaining the same positive-energy form or corresponding uniform spectral inequality.

The exact two-ground-state comparison uses the previously stipulated even-spinor lattice E8=D8 union(s+D8), the fixed actual Cartan dictionary and common current Hamiltonian. It is not a count for every chirality, independent spin lift or separately chosen sector-time law.
positive_results: Necessary neutral zero-partner criterion: a source-derived D5 carrier field corresponding to p*=((1/2)^4,(-1/2)^4) must be neutral, clock-invariant, and have the same common physical energy; the stipulated extension makes it a second ground state.

Exact analytic full-QWZ source gap: min|lambda| >= sin(pi/(2N)); scaled gap >= N sin(pi/(2N))/(2pi) >= 1/(2pi), with lower-bound limit 1/4. Six full matrices from the original builder agree and have no numerical zero modes.
Eightfold integer Cartan periodicity on the unchanged Hilbert space excludes operators with any half-integer Cartan Ward charge.

Reference sector classification: 16384 KLMVACUUM_REFERENCEV2Z labels; exactly 256 are D8-local, split 128 even and 128 odd, yielding the stated abstract local E8 charge-lattice class within that reference construction.
The source geometry f is deck invariant but not invariant under the pi/4 mark step; this counterexample does not rule out an additional physical rule selecting a quotient.
The previously stipulated rational Weyl map gives Mp*=e1+e4, an ordinary D5 carrier root orthogonal to the transported source U1 charge.
kills: The proposed multi-interval E8 completion on the unchanged charged-CAR/QWZ source with its actual Hilbert space, quarter state, Cartan action and common physical time.
A half-Cartan-charge E8 spinor operator on the original Hilbert space, because exp(2pi i N_k) acts trivially by adjoint action for integer occupation differences.
Using uniform holonomy compensation to lift the neutral p* partner; its total source U1 charge is zero.
Treating the vacuum-reference KLM label count as the proven actual quarter-source index, or deck invariance as a source-selected quotient rule.

The full vacuum-reference multi-interval dual as a bosonic local quotient: the dual label r=(1,3,0,...,0) has conformal spin 1/4 and is nonlocal; the actual quarter-source dual-index is separately unproved.

Promoting a total integer source charge into the eight half-integer Cartan Ward charges of an E8 spinor; the actual component generators have integer occupation differences and trivial 2pi adjoint action.
leaves_open: Derive the raw P1/P2 source field algebra, source state and common physical Hamiltonian/time.
Select a physical quotient and charged sectors, including their local observable completion, from the primitive source.
Exhibit the necessary neutral D5 zero-partner in a separately derived source, or derive a different source dictionary and recheck its state/time/action.
Other microscopic realizations and scalings; no universal exclusion is made.
not_claimed: No complete TFPT solution, four-dimensional physical closure, all-P1/P2 no-go, or Lean promotion.
No claim that KLMVACUUM_REFERENCEV2Z is the actual quarter-twisted source dual-index sector space.
No proof that deck invariance prohibits every possible physical relocalization or observable completion.
No physical gates closed; no source-paper, verification, or ledger promotion.
No choice of an added sector-dependent energy or clock lift is derived from the original neutral/charged-CAR input data.

additional_checks.description: six actual original-QWZ full-matrix spectra plus exact rational Weyl transport
